solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/reordered-power-of-2/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

869. Reordered Power of 2

You are given an integer n. We reorder the digits in any order (including the original order) such that the leading digit is not zero.

Return true if and only if we can do this so that the resulting number is a power of two.

Example 1:

Input: n = 1
Output: true

Example 2:

Input: n = 10
Output: false

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 10^9
"""


class Solution:
    def reorderedPowerOf2(self, n: int) -> bool:
        from collections import Counter

        def digits_count(x: int) -> Tuple[int]:
            return tuple(sorted(str(x)))

        target = digits_count(n)

        # Check all powers of two up to 10^9 (max 30 bits)
        for i in range(31):
            if digits_count(1 << i) == target:
                return True
        return False


sol = Solution()

print(sol.reorderedPowerOf2(1))  # True

assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(1) == True
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(10) == False

assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(0) == False
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(2) == True
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(16) == True
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(61) == True
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(46) == True

assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(1073741824) == True
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(2147483648) == False
assert sol.reorderedPowerOf2(999999999) == False
